name: Cymbeline
summary: Cymbeline is a statement of modern refinement. The back and piping are upholstered in soft, tailored fabric, creating subtle contrast and depth. Its silhouette is grounded by legs finished in a matte black gold powder, adding a touch of quiet opulence. With clean lines and a confident presence, it brings a sense of sophistication to any interior. 59.5×58.5×75.5
